name: Explain duplicate candidates before creating a person
title: SC-12-03-03 Explain duplicate candidates before creating a person
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the manager enters details matching an existing person
When duplicate detection returns candidate reasons
Then the form lists those reasons and requires explicit confirmation to create a distinct person
